name: Accessible File Manager
description: Provides accessible file inventory, exploration, access rules, download analytics, and secure file lifecycle management for Drupal.
project_description: Accessible File Manager (accessible_file_manager) is an accessibility-first file management, security, upload, and analytics toolkit for Drupal 10 and 11. It connects Drupal-managed File entities with files stored under the public:// and private:// stream wrappers and adds a WAI-ARIA File Explorer, an enhanced files inventory built on the core files View, download analytics, configurable render- and download-time access rules, token-based automatic filenaming, guarded orphan-cleanup workflows, and accessible file and image upload widgets. Every physical file operation is bounded to its stream-wrapper root, and a private-directory .htaccess security guard self-heals the protection file on cron and on every admin request. Version 1.1.0 adds a toolbar/navigation dashboard, semantic multiple-file lists, keyboard-accessible ordering, predictable AJAX focus, screen-reader announcements, and image descriptions of up to 2048 characters.
